messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout metrics: spike in 5xx (from 0.2% -> 3.4%) and 95th latency doubled on /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Rolling group: model-quant-v2. auto-rollback not triggered because transient errors under threshold.
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-4567: Canary anomaly detected for model-quant-v2 in eu-west-1. Pager oncall: @sre_anya. ETA to assign: immediate.
sre_anya: looking. Paging @runtime-eddie and @eng-ops-bot. any recent infra changes?
runtime-eddie: no infra deploys in last hour. I see repeated "kv-cache-miss" errors then OOMs on a subset of pods. Logs show segfault in quant kernel in gpu0 on a few hosts.
eng-ops-bot: Noted hosts with failures: gpu-host-34, gpu-host-36. Marking them as quarantined for scheduler.
product-maya: are customers impacted? any user-facing errors?
support-luis: support queue: ~18 requests from EU customers in last 20m showing truncated streaming responses or error code 502.
sre_anya: severity: degrade for EU customers on streaming endpoints. Action: immediate traffic shift off canary and flip feature flag. Who can flip the flag now?
runtime-eddie: I can. Plan: 1) flip feature flag model_v2_enable=false, 2) scale down canary replica set to 0, 3) pin service to model_v1, 4) run smoke tests. Doing step 1 now.
runtime-eddie: /flip-flag model_v2_enable=false --region eu-west-1
eng-ops-bot: Feature flag flip acknowledged. New flag state: model_v2_enable=false (eu-west-1).
sre_anya: start traffic drain for canary pods and remove from LB.
runtime-eddie: Draining replicas from kube: kubectl -n inference scale deploy/canary-quant-v2 --replicas=0
eng-ops-bot: Drain in progress. Pods terminating: canary-quant-v2-57f8, canary-quant-v2-5c9b.
support-luis: quick note: notified affected customers about degraded streaming responses; included workaround: retry with non-streaming endpoint where possible.
product-maya: nice. keep comms short with PG on status.
sre_anya: once drain completes, we'll pin traffic to model_v1. runtime-eddie, prepare rollback package (model artifact + config sha).
runtime-eddie: preparing pinned manifest: model:v1@sha256:9a7f... Config: inference-config-2026-03-17T11. I'll apply when drain finishes.
eng-ops-bot: Drain complete. No canary pods remaining in eu-west-1. LB health checks show 100% healthy on model_v1 pool.
runtime-eddie: Applying pin: kubectl apply -f pinned-model-v1-manifest.yaml
runtime-eddie: pinned.
sre_anya: start smoke tests: curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'x-test-smoke: true' and check for 200 and <250ms median.
eng-ops-bot: Smoke tests results: 20/20 requests 200 OK; median latency 120ms; 95th 210ms.
sre_anya: good. Rollback complete. Mark incident as mitigated for customer impact. Next: postmortem runbook items: reproduce locally, root-cause kernel segfault in quant path, add kernel guard and patch.
runtime-eddie: capturing core dumps and kernel logs from gpu-host-34/36. Uploading to /mnt/bugs/INC-2026-4567.
product-maya: customer impact summary for SEV doc: ~18 requests affected, no data loss, transient streaming truncation; impacted region eu-west-1, time window ~11:27–11:38 UTC. Please add to incident timeline.
support-luis: customers notified that service is restored and engineering is investigating root cause. Raised support ticket follow-ups.
sre_anya: follow-ups: (1) add automated canary check for quant kernel segfault signature, (2) lower canary traffic threshold that triggers auto-rollback, (3) add probe to exercise long streams (4) add scheduled pod reboots on suspect host pool.
eng-ops-bot: Noted follow-ups. Creating backlog items: RB-2341, RB-2342, RB-2343.
runtime-eddie: quick snippet of the failing log:
```
[2026-03-17T11:30:12Z] inference: quant_kernel.c:1024: panic: GPU_KERNEL_SIGSEGV ip=0x7ff... tid=2345
traceback: ...
args: seq_len=8192, batch=1, kv_hits=0
```
sre_anya: thanks. adding to timeline. anyone need handoff to on-call tomorrow?
product-maya: handoff to next SRE on shift please. I'll draft customer postmortem blurb.
sre_anya: handing off to @sre_rob for daytime shift. Rob — brief: INC-2026-4567, mitigated, root cause suspected quant kernel segfault on model-quant-v2; follow-ups in RB-2341..RB-2343.
sre_rob: acknowledged. I'll pick this up morning and coordinate perf regression test. thx.
eng-ops-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Closing alert but incident ticket remains open for RCA and fixes.
incident-bot: INC-2026-4567 updated: mitigated at 3113456842. Assigned owners: runtime-eddie (action), eng-ops (backlog), product-maya (customer comms).
